title: Finance Schedule: Suspended-Day Credit on an Overdue Delivery Pass Cycle (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
When a Delivery & Pickup Services plan settles an overdue billing cycle, the suspended-day credit is taken off the plan's subscription fee for that cycle. The suspended-day credit of an overdue-cycle settlement depends on how many subscription fees the plan has already had collected, counted as the collected subscription fee entries on the plan's fee ledger.

## Schedule

| Collected subscription fees already on the plan | Suspended-day credit |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the subscription fee multiplied by the days past due and divided by the days in the overdue cycle, rounded to the cent |
| at least 1 but fewer than 3 (that is, 1 or 2) | only whole weeks past due are credited: the subscription fee multiplied by 7 times the number of whole weeks in the days past due, divided by the days in the overdue cycle, rounded to the cent |
| none | no credit; the subscription fee is collected for the whole cycle |

## Terms

- **Days past due.** The calendar days from the date the charge failed to the settlement date, the failure date not counted and the settlement date counted.
- **Days in the overdue cycle.** The days from the overdue cycle's start date to its end date, both dates counted.
- **Whole weeks.** The number of complete 7-day weeks in the days past due; any remaining days are not credited in the middle band.
- The credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end of its working.

## Band edges

- A plan with 3 collected subscription fees falls in the first band; one with 2 falls in the middle band.
- A plan with 1 collected subscription fee falls in the middle band; one with none earns no credit.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Plan fee $5.99; overdue cycle 1 May to 31 May (31 days); charge failed on 1 May; settled on 10 May, so 9 days past due (2 May to 10 May).

| Collected subscription fees on the plan | Working | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 5.99 multiplied by 9, divided by 31, is 1.7390… | $1.74 |
| 2 | 9 days hold 1 whole week; 5.99 multiplied by 7 times 1, divided by 31, is 1.3525… | $1.35 |
| 0 | no credit | $0.00 |

With the same plan settled on 16 May (15 days past due, 2 whole weeks), a plan with 2 collected fees is credited 5.99 multiplied by 14 and divided by 31, which is 2.7051…, so $2.71.
